_comment: WASP-39b baseline v2 (nautilus, n_eff 5000): Retry C two-pass chemistry, per-instrument noise inflation, log10gamma down to -3, 792 lanes. Keys starting with _ are dropped (run_smc.make_config). Every key but walltime_seconds enters the target manifest, so run it in a fresh SMC_RETRIEVAL_OUT_DIR. Env, not Config: NAUTILUS_N_EFF=5000, VULCAN_JAX_CHEM_RHS=grouped, PROFILE_BATCH=3 (see run_nas_w39b.pbs, BASELINE V2).
_cfg_overrides: REPLACES case.py's dict, so Rp (1.21 R_J, case.py) is restated. rtol 0.1: the first-pass step tolerance (W39b.yaml default 0.2). queue_compact: VULCAN-JAX run_queue tail compaction 792 -> 264 -> 132 lanes (needs VULCAN-JAX >= 01f1558; the retry program inherits it, config_schema.retry_profile).
_chem_retry: Retry C: a draw uncertified (VULCAN's own certificate) within 3000 accepted steps at rtol 0.1 is re-solved once from the same start at rtol 0.2 within 5000; still uncertified -> rejected (analysis/fix_investigation/bistability/out/rtol_arms_main_summary.json RETRY_C). warm_count_max stays 1500 <= count_max.
_noise: one b per group (NIRISS, G395H_NRS1, G395H_NRS2), each log10_uniform on prior_noise_inflation (0.5, 3); needs infer_noise_inflation (on in the gpu preset). n_dim 13 -> 15.
_priors: log10gamma lower bound -2 -> -3 (draft_overrides_priors_v2.json). lnKzz keeps [ln 0.1, ln 1000]: no validation solve below ln 0.1 exists and the lowest covered band certifies worst (baseline rehearsal report). Tint and log10kappa unchanged.
_lanes: x FFI_BLOCKS_PER_SM 3 (run_nautilus) = 792 lanes; n_batch defaults to 3 x 792 = 2376 unless NAUTILUS_N_BATCH is set
_walltime: nautilus governor 46 h for a 48 h PBS wall (target-free: a RESUME may change it)
